surfaces.name: CCC dashboard (local web app, vanilla JS + stdlib Python server)
CCC macOS app (WKWebView shell with Sparkle updates)

WatchTower queue engine and wt CLI (separate repository)

claims.answer: Browser dashboard on localhost (macOS, Linux, Windows install), ccc CLI, macOS app shell, iOS Capacitor shell built from source, VS Code extension with two commands; phone use is the dashboard in a phone browser over Tailscale (experimental). No Android app.

scope.plan: Free, local install; FSL-1.1-MIT (CCC), WatchTower source-available non-commercial license

desktop_os.answer: macOS app shell (DMG), Linux via run.sh/systemd and native Windows via install.ps1 foreground; the dashboard itself runs in any browser.

mobile_apps.answer: iOS Capacitor shell exists in ios-app/ but must be built in Xcode; no Android app found in the repository.

browser.answer: The dashboard is a web app served at http://localhost:8090.

mobile_browser.answer: Phone access wizard exposes the full dashboard to a phone browser via Tailscale serve; flagged Experimental and off by default.

cli.answer: Product-owned ccc CLI (sessions, spawn, send, ask, share, models, quota, doctor, vault).

editor_extensions.answer: VS Code extension 0.1.0 offers Spawn session and Open dashboard only; no JetBrains extension found.

task_actions.answer: Start (spawn), steer (send --steer / composer), answer permission prompts and questions inline, review transcripts, resume dormant sessions by sending.

notifications.answer: Dashboard attention markers, macOS/Linux desktop notifications for reminders and On-call messages over email, Telegram, ntfy, iMessage, SMS and WhatsApp.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Sessions live on the host; the phone browser and macOS shell connect to the same server and agents keep running when the page closes.

limitations: iOS shell is source-built (no store release documented); phone access is flagged Experimental and exposes the dashboard to the whole tailnet.

claims.answer: Nine engines spawn from the dashboard: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Kilo Code, Kimi Code, Grok, OpenCode and Devin (local CLI); Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot Chat are read-only. CCC launches or controls each CLI or ACP transport; it does not embed its own harness.

harnesses.answer: Nine spawnable engines documented; two read-only.

model_providers.answer: Provider keys via BYOK profiles, free-model router, plus whatever each engine CLI supports; model catalog from GET /api/engines/models.

custom_adapters.answer: The repository has adapter modules (ccc_acp.py, ccc_server/acp.py, aider.py, droid.py, hermes.py) and an experimental ACP bridge; no documented third-party adapter API for users.

session_integration.answer: Claude and Codex via headless stream-json/app-server, Kimi and Grok via ACP, others by launching their CLI; each has its own transcript reader.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: One session list shows all engines and WatchTower queues can use claude, codex or kimi workers; group chats and ccc ask work across engines.

limitations: Not fully established: custom_adapters.

evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: Overview; Set it up; Engine support; Quickstart; License
evidence.finding: CCC is a local dashboard and On-call preview that attaches to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Kilo Code, Kimi Code, OpenCode, Grok and Devin sessions; install via curl script, Homebrew, macOS DMG, Windows PowerShell; nothing hosted; FSL-1.1-MIT; one anonymous daily ping with CCC_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 to turn off.

evidence.title: LICENSE
evidence.locator: Functional Source License 1.1, MIT Future License
evidence.finding: FSL-1.1-MIT, copyright Amir Fish: any purpose except Competing Use; each release converts to MIT on the second anniversary.

evidence.title: NOTICE
evidence.finding: Versions before 2026-07-28 are MIT (LICENSE-MIT); 2026-07-28 to the FSL switch used a separate Claude Command Center Software License; some third-party contributions (Grok, Kilo Code/ACP adapter) remain MIT.

evidence.title: SECURITY.md
evidence.locator: Threat model; What we do to enforce the boundary; What we don't do
evidence.finding: Single-user single-host loopback trust model, no accounts or permissions, headless Claude spawned with --dangerously-skip-permissions, optional Tailscale phone access with optional PIN, agent-config consent, no sandbox, no encryption at rest, no rate limiting.

evidence.title: docs/engine-support.md
evidence.finding: Nine spawnable engines with per-engine resume, transcript source and model/effort controls; Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot Chat read-only; Cursor IDE metadata only.

evidence.title: docs/architecture.md
evidence.locator: Persistent execution worker; Data sources; Data sinks
evidence.finding: Stdlib Python server with vanilla JS UI; ccc-worker owns agent transports over a mode-0600 Unix socket with a SQLite control-plane ledger (idempotency keys, leases, uncertain state); sidecar JSON under ~/.claude/command-center.

evidence.title: docs/cli.md
evidence.finding: ccc sessions, spawn, send, ask, share, models, quota, doctor, vault, remind, app; reads port.txt for server base URL.

evidence.title: docs/orchestration.md
evidence.locator: Spawn a session; Read and ask
evidence.finding: POST /api/sessions/spawn (engine, model, reasoning_effort, report_to, parent_session_id, idempotency_key), /api/ask, /api/inject-input, /api/usage/current; ccc-orchestration skill lets an agent spawn siblings and ask them.

evidence.title: docs/QUEUES.md
evidence.locator: What a queue is; basics; troubleshooting
evidence.finding: WatchTower queues of tickets drained in parallel by workers, wt status/ls/drain/claim/close/release/wait, reconciler releases dead claims, wt config --workers N.

evidence.title: docs/features.md
evidence.locator: Organize and read work; Start and steer agents; Keep work moving; Costs; On-call; Phone access
evidence.finding: Fleet list, Flow canvas, split conversations, board view, full-text search, fresh worktree spawns, permission prompts answered inline, queue inbox, plan-to-fleet, GitHub issue integration, Decision Inbox, usage tracking, free models, group chats, 12-skill pack.

evidence.title: docs/kanban-rules.md
evidence.finding: Board columns Backlog, Needs attention, Icebox, Working, Review, In Testing, Verified, Archived derived from sessions, GitHub issues and TODO.md.

evidence.title: docs/session-attach.md
evidence.finding: CCC reads each engine's own transcripts and live registries; hooks write live-state sidecars; closing CCC does not stop agents; headless spawns use claude -p stream-json with --dangerously-skip-permissions.

evidence.title: docs/phone-access.md
evidence.finding: Experimental Phone access wizard runs tailscale serve to expose the dashboard on the tailnet, QR code, optional PIN; phone uses the browser dashboard.

evidence.title: ios-app/README.md
evidence.finding: Capacitor WKWebView iOS shell that connects to the HTTPS phone URL; built by the user in Xcode, no store release documented.

evidence.title: scripts/macapp/main.swift
evidence.locator: File header; imports Cocoa WebKit Sparkle
evidence.finding: Native macOS shell is a thin WKWebView around the localhost dashboard, can point at a remote CCC server, installs the server on first launch, updates with Sparkle.

evidence.title: vscode-extension/package.json
evidence.finding: VS Code extension 0.1.0 (MIT) with commands claudeCommandCenter.spawnSession and openDashboard; talks to a local CCC server.

evidence.title: docs/worktree-init.md
evidence.finding: Worktree toggle creates <parent>/<repo>-wt/<slug>/ on feat/<slug>; optional executable .ccc/worktree-init runs once with CCC_WORKTREE_PATH, CCC_PARENT_REPO, CCC_SESSION_NAME.

evidence.title: docs/telemetry.md
evidence.finding: One anonymous daily beacon (schema_version, version, platform, two booleans), no install id, CCC_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 is the only switch; opt-in ping retired 2026-09-28.

evidence.title: docs/byok-and-vault.md
evidence.finding: Provider API keys in named profiles in Settings > Engines; Vault for other secrets.

evidence.title: docs/free-models.md
evidence.finding: Local freellmapi router on 127.0.0.1 forwards agent requests to free LLM providers; $0 runs; keyless provider may log prompts for training.

evidence.title: docs/tos-boundary.md
evidence.finding: CCC runs the user's installed claude CLI with its own login, reads plan usage about every 5 minutes, never shares the login.

evidence.title: docs/usage-db.md
evidence.finding: Local SQLite throughput database with per-session tokens and list-price cost across Claude Code, Codex and Kimi; plan fees, runrate, breakeven; read-only on source stores.

evidence.title: docs/allowances.md
evidence.finding: Allowances app keeps multiple Codex accounts with separate CLI homes, quota reads, automatic model-based account moves; new sessions can pick an account.

evidence.title: docs/plan-to-fleet.md
evidence.finding: wt import turns a Markdown plan into WatchTower tickets with dependency order after preview and approval; Drain starts workers.

evidence.title: docs/oncall.md
evidence.locator: Where bugs come from; replies; customer approval
evidence.finding: On-call (preview, off by default) files tickets from email, GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, URL checks and commands, messages owner over email/Telegram/ntfy/iMessage/SMS/WhatsApp, replies become agent answers, customer messages need approval.

evidence.title: docs/oncall-security.md
evidence.finding: On-call security model: reports are hostile input, thread tokens are bearer credentials, approval gates customer messages and tool approvals.

evidence.title: docs/oncall-reliability.md
evidence.finding: On-call stores send intent before side effects, reports queues WatchTower marks stuck, does not restart or reassign work.

evidence.title: docs/cloud-relay/README.md
evidence.finding: Optional account-based hosted relay that shows a minimized status snapshot to a phone browser and returns bounded actions; the laptop remains the execution environment.

evidence.title: docs/cloud-relay/SECURITY-AND-PRIVACY.md
evidence.finding: Hosted relay holds routing metadata only; wire contract and hosted service are not in this repository.

evidence.title: docs/group-chat-pinging.md
evidence.finding: Group chats ping participants on a post; watcher 30 s tick, 60 s throttle.

evidence.title: docs/decision-memory.md
evidence.finding: ccc decisions and Ask retrieve captured user decision quotes with transcript path, line and engine; read-only ccc-state MCP tool.

evidence.title: docs/agent-config-consent.md
evidence.finding: CCC writes hooks and skills into agent config only after per-item approval with diff and backups.

evidence.title: docs/decision-inbox.md
evidence.finding: Decision Inbox lists owner questions and stalled work from queues and sessions; answering disabled by default.

evidence.title: ccc_server/runaway.py
evidence.finding: Detects sessions that keep waking autonomously without productive turns or over budget; flagged for the owner.

evidence.title: docs/sharing.md
evidence.finding: ccc share builds a redacted replay page and image locally; nothing is uploaded.

evidence.title: docs/install.md
evidence.finding: Install paths for macOS, Linux (systemd user service), WSL2, native Windows (foreground) and Docker.

evidence.title: docs/roadmap.md
evidence.finding: Roadmap file last updated 2026-05-19, grouped shipped/planned without dates; README now points to features and engine docs.

evidence.title: CHANGELOG.md
evidence.finding: Release notes for v5.46.0 including Antigravity accounts, apps, routines and CI display.

evidence.title: .github/workflows/ci.yml
evidence.finding: CI runs the Python test suite, JS checks and the telemetry worker tests on each push.

evidence.title: docs/periodic-triggers.md
evidence.finding: Dashboard UI pollers (1 s to 60 s) refresh sessions, issues and deploy pills; these are UI refresh timers, not agent schedulers.

evidence.title: control_plane.py
evidence.finding: Control-plane ledger with idempotency keys, leases and parent-child edges for worker-owned spawns and turns.

evidence.title: hooks/permission-request.py
evidence.finding: Claude Code PermissionRequest hook feeding the dashboard approval prompts.

evidence.title: ccc_server/engines.py
evidence.finding: Engine spawn code takes worktree option and records effective worktree kind.

evidence.title: ccc_server/fleet_jobs.py
evidence.locator: gh pr merge --squash and git merge --ff-only
evidence.finding: Fleet jobs run gh pr merge --squash and fast-forward merges as dashboard actions.

evidence.title: server.py
evidence.finding: Server detects PRs created by sessions (gh pr create) and offers merge (gh pr merge --squash) and verify/archive actions with GitHub issue linking.

evidence.title: ccc_server/
evidence.locator: bounded search: saml, oidc, scim, rbac, sso, organization, seat; spend cap, max_budget, max-turns
evidence.finding: Bounded search of ccc_server/, server.py and docs at the pinned commit found no SSO/SAML/SCIM, role or seat model and no per-session spend cap flag (only runaway flags and plan-limit meters).

evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: Usage; Agent engines; GitHub Issues backend; Resolutions
evidence.finding: WatchTower queue engine: wt add/edit/claim/close/import, engines claude/codex/kimi, GitHub-issues backend, dedupe keys, duplicate links, resolutions, wt wait, dashboard on 127.0.0.1:8787.

evidence.title: LICENSE
evidence.finding: WatchTower Software License: all rights reserved, individual non-commercial use only; commercial use needs separate terms.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 220 stars, license NOASSERTION (FSL-1.1-MIT), pushed 2026-11-17; latest release v5.46.0 (2026-11-14).

evidence.finding: Product site carries the README story, live demo at /demo/ and no pricing page (https://ccc.amirfish.ai/pricing returns 404).

evidence.finding: README screenshot of the v5.43 session list and open transcript on synthetic demo sessions.
